description: This file defines a class 'EventMigrationStatsDetail' that models details about migration statistics for calendar events, including their type, identifiers, names, messages, and reasons. It appears to be part of a migration or synchronization process within a SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: EventMigrationStatsDetail
